description: EBSD (OIM) map group rendered as a 3 × 3 array, all in the HR + CR + 1023 K condition, with ND (top) and RD (left) marked by arrows. Rows are the alloys — 28Mn0Ni (a–c), 28Mn5Ni (d–f), 15Mn5Ni (g–i); columns are the map types — coloured IPF maps of austenite (a, d, g; 20 µm scale bars), phase-contrast maps (b, e, h; inset legend blue = B2, red = FCC), and KAM maps (c, f, i; legend Min 0 – Max 5, unit not printed). (a) shows fine equiaxed, randomly coloured austenite grains; (d) shows strongly banded, elongated grains with a dashed-box inset at higher magnification (2 µm scale bar) of fine recrystallized grains; (g) carries an IPF colour triangle labelled 001/101/111 and dark unindexed bands. The phase maps change markedly between rows: (b) is essentially all red with sparse fine blue B2 particles, (e) is red with a few thin blue stringers, (h) contains abundant coarse blue B2 stringers elongated along RD. KAM is almost uniformly blue (low) in (c) but green–yellow (higher) in (f) and (i), greatest for 15Mn5Ni. The figure therefore links Mn/Ni ratio to B2 stringer density, retained stored strain and the extent of austenite recrystallization at 1023 K.
measured_quantities: kernel average misorientation (KAM) — colour scale Min 0 to Max 5, unit not printed
phase distribution / area fraction of FCC (austenite) versus B2, colour-coded
grain size and band width (µm), via 20 µm and 2 µm scale bars

observations.observation: The figure is a 3 × 3 array of EBSD maps, all acquired in the HR + CR + 1023 K condition, with rows = alloys (28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni, 15Mn5Ni) and columns = map type (coloured IPF, phase contrast, KAM).

Panel (b) is almost entirely red (FCC) with only sparse fine blue B2 particles; panel (e) is red with a few thin blue B2 stringers; panel (h) contains numerous coarse blue B2 stringers elongated along RD, so B2 stringer content increases in the order 28Mn0Ni < 28Mn5Ni < 15Mn5Ni.
The phase-map legend printed inside panel (b) assigns blue to B2 and red to FCC.
The KAM colour-scale legend is labelled 'Min 0' and 'Max 5'; the unit of the scale is not printed on the figure.
KAM maps become progressively warmer (green to yellow) from (c) to (f) to (i), i.e. local misorientation is lowest in 28Mn0Ni and highest in 15Mn5Ni.
Panels (a), (d) and (g) each carry a 20 µm scale bar; the inset of (d) carries a 2 µm scale bar.
Panel (a) shows fine equiaxed, multi-coloured austenite grains, whereas (d) and (g) show strongly banded and elongated grain morphologies with dark unindexed bands.
Panel (g) contains an IPF colour triangle key whose corners are labelled 001, 101 and 111.
The caption states that the inset of (d) shows the coloured IPF map at higher magnification revealing the fine recrystallized austenite grains.

The caption states the maps are of 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni alloys in the HR + CR + 1023 K condition, with (a–c), (d–f) and (g–i) being the coloured IPF (austenite), phase-contrast and KAM maps respectively.
The citing text states that nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along the γ/γ boundaries and the γ/B2 interface in these alloys.
The citing text states that stringer B2 can act as a particle-stimulated-nucleation (PSN) site and aids recrystallization in the Ni-containing alloys.

subfigures.description: Coloured IPF map for austenite in 28Mn0Ni after HR+CR+1023 K; fine, equiaxed, randomly oriented grains with many distinct colours, with a 20 µm scale bar and ND/RD axes.
Phase-contrast map of 28Mn0Ni; nearly uniform red (FCC) matrix with sparse, fine blue (B2) particles dispersed within grains. Inset legend reads blue = B2, red = FCC.
KAM map of 28Mn0Ni; almost uniformly dark blue (near-minimum misorientation) with only a few isolated green/yellow-green spots, indicating low stored strain.

Coloured IPF map of 28Mn5Ni; strongly banded, elongated grains. A dashed-box inset with a 2 µm scale bar shows the same orientation mapping at higher magnification, revealing fine recrystallized austenite grains. 20 µm scale bar.
Phase-contrast map of 28Mn5Ni; red FCC matrix with a small number of thin, mostly vertically (RD-aligned) oriented blue B2 stringers.
KAM map of 28Mn5Ni; mixed green and yellow fields with blue low-misorientation patches, indicating intermediate-to-high local misorientation relative to (c).
Coloured IPF map of 15Mn5Ni; banded structure with dark (unindexed or non-austenite) bands; contains an IPF colour triangle key with corners labelled 001, 101 and 111, and a 20 µm scale bar.
Phase-contrast map of 15Mn5Ni; red FCC matrix traversed by numerous elongated blue B2 stringers/bands aligned along the RD direction — the highest B2 fraction of the three alloys shown.
KAM map of 15Mn5Ni; predominantly green–yellow (elevated misorientation) with dark bands corresponding to the unindexed stringers, indicating the highest retained stored strain of the three alloys.
